name: Switzerland
notes: Swiss prices are worked out in euros. Lift passes are typical 6-day prices; many Swiss resorts now use dynamic pricing, so booking early is cheaper.

locations.name: Champéry
locations.character: Chalet village with a lively main street. A cable car climbs to the Swiss side of the Portes du Soleil.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h30. Train from Aigle or Monthey to the village.

links.note: Cable car up to Planachaux, ski to Les Crosets

park.note: Small fun zones. The bigger parks are at Les Crosets and Avoriaz.

expert.note: The Swiss Wall at Chavanette, one of the steepest marked runs in the Alps.

locations.name: Morgins
locations.easyStart: Beginner area beside the village, with a short walk from most chalets.
locations.character: Quiet family village on the Swiss side of the pass, linked by lift and piste to Châtel.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h30. Bus from Monthey or Troistorrents station.

links.note: Ski across to Châtel and the French side

park.note: A small park with a few jumps and rails.

expert.note: Gentle home slopes, with the steeper Swiss side a few lifts away.

locations.name: Les Crosets
locations.character: Small ski-in ski-out hamlet in the middle of the Swiss Portes du Soleil. Big après-ski bar, little else.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h40. Bus from Val-d'Illiez.

park.note: A proper park with easy and medium lines, close to the hamlet.

expert.note: Steep runs and off-piste towards the Swiss Wall and Avoriaz.

locations.name: Champoussin
locations.character: Small, quiet ski-in ski-out spot above Val-d'Illiez, on the lift link to Les Crosets.
locations.transfer: Car about 1h40. Bus from Val-d'Illiez in season.

links.note: Lifts and pistes to Les Crosets

park.note: Only small fun zones nearby. Les Crosets has the park.

expert.note: Mostly cruising, with the steeper Swiss Wall area nearby.

locations.name: Torgon
locations.character: Small, low and quiet village at the northern tip of the Portes du Soleil, linked to La Chapelle-d'Abondance.
locations.transfer: Car about 1h20. Bus from Vionnaz station.

park.note: A small fun zone.

expert.note: Mostly gentle and low.

locations.name: Villars
locations.easyStart: Rack railway from the village straight to the gentle Bretaye bowl.
locations.character: Year-round village with international schools, shops and a rack railway up to Bretaye. Easy, sunny skiing.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h20. Train to Bex, then rack railway to the village.

park.note: A proper park at Bretaye with a beginner line.

expert.note: Some off-piste and steeper runs, with Glacier 3000 a drive away.

locations.name: Leysin
locations.character: Sunny balcony village with international schools and a long freestyle history. Good value for Switzerland.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h20. Train to Aigle, then the rack railway up.

park.note: A well-known freestyle park with a beginner line.

expert.note: Some steeper runs and off-piste from the Berneuse.

locations.name: Les Diablerets
locations.snowNote: Glacier 3000 nearby keeps snow late in the season.
locations.character: Traditional chalet village under the cliffs of the Diablerets, with Glacier 3000 above for high snow.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h30. Train from Aigle to the village.

park.note: A small park.

expert.note: Some steep runs and off-piste, plus Glacier 3000.

locations.name: Verbier
locations.character: Famous freeride resort on a sunny shelf, with big nightlife and big prices. The heart of the 4 Vallées.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h. Train to Le Châble, then the gondola up.

links.note: Lifts over Les Attelas and Tortin

park.note: A proper park at La Chaux with lines for each level.

expert.note: Mont Fort, the Tortin mogul field and famous off-piste.

locations.name: Nendaz
locations.character: Big, sunny village above Sion with real shops and calmer prices, linked to the whole 4 Vallées.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h. Bus from Sion.

park.note: A proper park with lines for beginners and improvers.

expert.note: Mont Fort and Tortin are close, with big off-piste.

locations.name: Veysonnaz
locations.character: Small, quiet village with a famous World Cup run down to it, linked to the 4 Vallées.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h. Bus from Sion.

park.note: A small fun zone.

expert.note: The steep Piste de l'Ours, with the big terrain of the 4 Vallées beyond.

locations.name: Thyon
locations.easyStart: Beginner slopes right outside the apartments.
locations.character: High, purpose-built ski-in ski-out spot with wide views, on the quiet side of the 4 Vallées.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h10. Bus from Sion.

park.note: A well-known park with lines for beginners and improvers.

expert.note: Some off-piste on the open slopes.

locations.name: La Tzoumaz
locations.character: Quiet village in the trees on the Savoleyres side of Verbier, at lower prices.
locations.transfer: Car about 1h50. Bus from Riddes.

park.note: A small fun zone.

expert.note: Tree runs locally, with Verbier's big terrain over the hill.

locations.name: Crans-Montana
locations.character: Large, sunny resort town on a plateau with smart shops, golf-course views and long, easy runs.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h. Train to Sierre, then the funicular up.

park.note: A proper park with lines for each level.

expert.note: Mostly cruising, with steeper runs and off-piste from the Plaine Morte glacier.

locations.name: Anzère
locations.easyStart: Car-free village square with the nursery slope beside it.
locations.character: Small, car-free sunny village above Sion with a compact ski area. Calm and easy.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h. Bus from Sion.

park.note: A small park.

expert.note: Some off-piste on the open slopes.

locations.name: Grimentz-Zinal
locations.character: Old wooden village with flower boxes and dark larch chalets, linked by cable car to Zinal. Big off-piste.
locations.transfer: Car about 2h20. Bus from Sierre.

park.note: A small park.

expert.note: Big off-piste and steep runs in a quiet valley.

locations.name: Ovronnaz
locations.character: Small, sunny village with thermal baths. Gentle skiing for families on a budget.
locations.transfer: Car about 1h40. Bus from Leytron.

park.note: A small fun zone.

expert.note: Small and gentle.

locations.name: Leukerbad
locations.character: Spa town under huge cliffs, with Europe's largest Alpine thermal baths. Skiing across the valley at Torrent.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h20. Bus from Leuk station.

park.note: A small park.

expert.note: Some steeper runs and off-piste at Torrent.

locations.name: Saas-Fee
locations.snowNote: Glacier skiing up to 3,600 m keeps snow all season.
locations.character: Car-free glacier village ringed by 4,000 m peaks. Snow-sure, with skiing high on the Allalin glacier.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h45. Train to Visp, then the bus up.

park.note: A big glacier park, one of the best in the Alps, with lines for every level.

expert.note: High glacier terrain and off-piste, best with a guide.

locations.name: Zermatt
locations.snowNote: Glacier skiing up to 3,883 m keeps snow all season.
locations.character: Car-free town under the Matterhorn, linked to Cervinia in Italy. The highest skiing in the Alps.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 3h15. Train via Visp to Täsch, then the shuttle train.

park.note: A proper park on the glacier with lines for each level.

expert.note: High, big terrain and famous off-piste under the Matterhorn.

locations.name: Bettmeralp
locations.easyStart: Car-free village with the beginner slopes at the door.
locations.character: Car-free village in the Aletsch Arena, high above the Aletsch glacier. Reached by cable car from Betten.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 3h. Train to Betten, then the cable car up.

park.note: A proper park with lines for beginners and improvers.

expert.note: Some off-piste with glacier views.

locations.name: Gstaad
locations.character: Smart chalet town with luxury shops and quiet, scattered ski areas. Glacier 3000 is nearby.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h. Train via Montreux on the scenic GoldenPass line.

park.note: A small park.

expert.note: Some off-piste, with Glacier 3000 a drive away.

locations.name: Adelboden
locations.character: Traditional village at the end of a valley, home of the Chuenisbärgli World Cup slope. Linked to Lenk.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h30. Train to Frutigen, then the bus.

park.note: A well-known park with lines for each level.

expert.note: The steep Chuenisbärgli and some off-piste.

locations.name: Wengen
locations.character: Car-free village on a sunny ledge under the Eiger, reached by train. Long-time British favourite.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h45. Train via Interlaken and Lauterbrunnen.

links.note: Train or lifts via Kleine Scheidegg

park.note: A small park.

expert.note: The Lauberhorn run and some off-piste.

locations.name: Grindelwald
locations.character: Busy village under the Eiger north face, with skiing at First and over to Wengen.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h45. Train via Interlaken.

links.note: Lifts or train via Kleine Scheidegg

park.note: A proper park at First with lines for each level.

expert.note: Some off-piste at First and the Lauberhorn.

locations.name: Mürren
locations.character: Tiny car-free village on a cliff top, with the Schilthorn above. Quiet and dramatic.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 3h. Train via Lauterbrunnen, then cable car or mountain railway.

park.note: A small fun zone.

expert.note: Steep runs from the Schilthorn, home of the Inferno race.

locations.name: La Dôle
locations.character: Small, low ski area on the Jura ridge with views over Lake Geneva and Mont Blanc. Day trips from Geneva.
locations.transfer: Car about 45 min from Geneva.

links.note: Same lift pass as Les Rousses

park.note: A small fun zone.

expert.note: Small and gentle.

locations.name: Zinal
locations.character: Small village at the head of the Val d'Anniviers, linked by cable car to Grimentz.
locations.transfer: Car about 2h30. Bus from Sierre.

park.note: A small fun zone.

expert.note: Big off-piste and steep runs above the village.

locations.name: Riederalp
locations.easyStart: Car-free village with the beginner slopes at the door.
locations.character: Car-free village of the Aletsch Arena, reached by cable car from Mörel. Gentle and sunny.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 3h. Train to Mörel, then the cable car up.

park.note: Small fun zones. The main park is at Bettmeralp.

expert.note: Some off-piste with glacier views.

locations.name: Monthey
locations.character: Down-to-earth valley town with everyday prices and a mountain railway up to Champéry.
locations.transfer: Train from Geneva Airport about 1h15. Car 1h10.

locations.name: Aigle
locations.character: Wine town with a castle among the vineyards. Three mountain railways start at the station.
locations.transfer: Train from Geneva Airport about 1h15. Car 1h05.

locations.name: Bex
locations.character: Small, quiet town at the foot of the Villars railway, with lower prices than the resort.
locations.transfer: Train from Geneva Airport about 1h20. Car 1h10.

locations.name: Martigny
locations.character: Roman town at the bend of the Rhône, a train hub with easy access to the 4 Vallées.
locations.transfer: Train from Geneva Airport about 1h40. Car 1h25.

links.note: Train to Le Châble, then gondola

locations.name: Le Châble
locations.character: Village at the bottom of the Verbier gondola. Verbier's skiing at a lower price.
locations.transfer: Train from Geneva Airport about 2h. Car 1h50.

locations.name: Sion
locations.character: Capital of the Valais, with two castles on hills, an old town and everyday prices.
locations.transfer: Train from Geneva Airport about 2h. Car 1h40.

locations.name: Sierre
locations.character: Sunny wine town with a funicular straight up to Crans-Montana.
locations.transfer: Train from Geneva Airport about 2h10. Car 1h50.

locations.name: Visp
locations.character: Rail junction town at the entrance to the Zermatt and Saas valleys.
locations.transfer: Train from Geneva Airport about 2h30. Car 2h20.

links.note: Train up the valley to Zermatt

locations.name: Täsch
locations.character: Last village you can drive to before Zermatt. Cheaper beds and a 12-minute shuttle train.
locations.transfer: Train from Geneva Airport about 3h. Car 2h50.

locations.name: Brig
locations.character: Old trading town with a baroque castle, close to the Aletsch Arena cable cars.
locations.transfer: Train from Geneva Airport about 2h40. Car 2h30.

links.note: Train to Mörel, then cable car
Train to Betten, then cable car

locations.name: Interlaken
locations.character: Busy lakeside town between two lakes, with trains up to the Jungfrau ski region.
locations.transfer: Train from Geneva Airport about 2h50. Car 2h30.

locations.name: Lauterbrunnen
locations.character: Valley village of waterfalls and cliffs, with trains to Wengen and a cable car to Mürren.
locations.transfer: Train from Geneva Airport about 3h10. Car 2h45.

links.note: Cable car to Grütschalp, then train

locations.name: Frutigen
locations.character: Small valley town below Adelboden, with lower prices and a direct bus up.
locations.transfer: Train from Geneva Airport about 2h40. Car 2h20.
